top_strength: Nailed every pricing differentiator without a single miss — No Worries coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee, the full no-hidden-fees pitch, and a clean clock explanation, all delivered clearly in one unbroken pass.
coaching_note: The call skipped the Save Your Ass prep speech entirely and offered no budget-conscious framing when the customer said he wanted to shop around — both are easy adds that could have kept this lead warmer before he left to compare quotes.
phone_presence_notes: Polite and thorough throughout, but leans on repeated scripted affirmations ("Awesome") rather than genuine warmth, and doesn't acknowledge the customer's price-shopping hesitation at the end.
